svg.text: fetch JSON: reports, timelines, diffs, admin, login
signed event POSTs: JSON envelope or Slack/Teams message (HTTPS, HMAC-SHA256)
MCP tool calls with a read-only API token (Streamable HTTP)
GET /admin/backup/sqlite with a full API token (HTTPS)
emit facts: version published / deprecated, provide rejected, dependency recorded, branch cut, catalog recorded
hooks, outbox and delivery log (SpecRepository port)
manage hooks: create, test, rotate secret, list deliveries, redeliver (/admin/webhooks, per Producer and Consumer)
catalog queries: services, endpoints, specs, graph, diffs, blame
consistent SQLite snapshot (VACUUM INTO), streamed to the Backup Job
SSE / WebSocket live updates (provide, require, audit events)
